excerpt.zh: 我们在[planet.GetName]找到了第四个还未引爆的环境改造装置。将其取回之后就能让我们完全理解这一科技了。
excerpt.en: We have located a fourth, as yet undetonated terraforming device on [planet.GetName]. Recovering it will fill the gaps in our understanding of this technology.

label.zh: 我们还等什么？开始研究啊！
label.en: What are we waiting for? Begin the study!

label.zh: 风险远大于收益，摧毁装置。
label.en: The risks outweigh the rewards, destroy the device.

label.zh: 我们还等什么？开始研究啊！
label.en: What are we waiting for? Begin the study!

label.zh: 风险远大于收益，摧毁装置。
label.en: The risks outweigh the rewards, destroy the device.

texts.zh: 我们在[planet.GetName]找到了第四个还未引爆的环境改造装置。将其取回之后就能让我们完全理解这一科技了。
texts.en: We have located a fourth, as yet undetonated terraforming device on [planet.GetName]. Recovering it will fill the gaps in our understanding of this technology.

texts.zh: 我们找到了未启用的第四台装置，它完好地躺在[from.GetName]的地上。我们可以分析它的控制结构来获取复制该科技的知识。
texts.en: We have successfully located an intact fourth device, inactive on the surface of [from.GetName]. Analyzing its control architecture would give us the final knowledge needed to replicate this technology.

texts.zh: 一旦掌握了这项技术，我们就能从星系获得惊人的利润空间，至于环境问题微不足道。这对[controller.GetName]而言可是绝佳的机会。
texts.en: The staggering profit margins we will be able to reap from the galaxy once we master this technology outweigh the paltry environmental concerns. This is a golden opportunity for the [controller.GetName].

texts.zh: 这种技术在星系范围内自由部署的潜在后果引发了重大问题。
texts.en: The potential ramifications of freely deploying such technology on a galactic scale raise significant questions.

texts.zh: 也许在这些威胁被用来对付我们之前把它们从这个星系中消除会更好。
texts.en: Perhaps it would be better to remove this threat from the galaxy before it is used against us.

texts.zh: 也许把这些设备可能会给星系带来的危险移除也许会更好。
texts.en: Perhaps it would be better if the potential risk these devices pose was removed from the galaxy.

label.zh: 我们还等什么？开始研究啊！
label.en: What are we waiting for? Begin the study!

label.zh: 风险远大于收益，摧毁装置。
label.en: The risks outweigh the rewards, destroy the device.

texts.zh:
在研究[from.GetName]上的这台装置时，我们无意中触发了一个故障保险，警报赫然响彻所有频率。尽管最初预测不会有人应答，但还是有一架自动无人机进入了我们的领土。

我们的所有招呼都只得到相同的答复：

“尊敬的用户您好，记录显示您未经允许擅自仿制MKIII型地质辐射矩阵，该行为违反了科伯恩公司最终用户许可协议。

我们将行使法律权限，以极端强制措施终止您的企图。您有任何投诉可以直接联系我们的客服无人机。”
texts.en:
While studying the device on [from.GetName] we inadvertently triggered a failsafe, resulting in an all frequencies alert siren. Despite initial predictions this would be unanswered, an automated drone has entered our territory.

Our hails all receive the same response:

"Greetings valued customer, our records show you are attempting to create an unlicensed version of the latest MKIII Georadiation Matrix, a clear violation of CoburnCorp's End User License Agreement.

We will now be enforcing our legal authority to terminate your attempts with extreme prejudice. Any complaints can be directed towards our customer service drones."

texts.zh: 如果他们的这股勤奋劲不误我们的事儿就挺鼓舞人心的。
texts.en: Their diligence would be inspiring if it wasn't currently delaying our own work.

label.zh: 我们可不会跟“客服”多废话。
label.en: We will not negotiate with "customer support".

texts.zh:
随着信号接通，一段古老的音乐传来，自动服务台无人机上线了。

尊敬的用户您好，我们能看到您正在擅自仿制无证的MKIII型地质辐射矩阵。需要什么帮助？
texts.en:
As the connection goes live, archaic music plays before the automated help desk drone comes online.

Greetings valued customer, we can see that you are creating an unlicensed version of a MKIII Georadiation Matrix. How can we help you today?

label.en: Can we talk to your administrator?

label.zh: 我们只是捡了些破烂而已。
label.en: We assumed we were salvaging ruins.
We are willing to renew our subscription.

label.zh: 我们不会买这台装置的。
勒索来了。给它点颜色瞧瞧。

texts.zh:
随着[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]中的战斗进入尾声，一份来自客服无人机的新信息显示到了我们的屏幕上。

“我们留意到您对我方最终用户许可协议强制执行抗拒。由于您展现出压倒性军事力量，我们现正式废除对MKIII地质辐射矩阵的知识产权声索。我们希望您能在使用这一新科技的过程中获得快乐。”

无人机发生了爆炸，同时切断了通讯链接。
texts.en:
As the battle draws to a close in [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName], a new communication from the customer service drone plays on our screens.

"We have noted your objection to our efforts to enforce the terms of the End User License Agreement. As a result of your display of overwhelming military might, we will now rescind our claim to the intellectual property of the MKIII Georadiation Matrix. We hope you enjoy your newly acquired technology."

The drone explodes, severing the communication link.

texts.zh: 处理掉了客服无人机后，我们现在就可以继续逆向工程这台地质辐射矩阵了。
texts.en: With the customer service drones dealt with, we are now able to resume retro-engineering the Georadiation Matrix.

texts.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的企业家级效率，我们重新设计了MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进操作方法来产生最大的利润。
texts.en: Through relentless entrepreneurial efficiency, we have retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, refining its operational methods to yield maximum profit.

texts.zh: 通过深入的研究工作，我们得以重新设计MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进流程解锁了其全部的潜力。
texts.en: After extensive study, we have successfully retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, unlocking its potential with added improvements to the process.

texts.zh: 通过将放射性分子去稳技术整合进环境改造设备，现在我们可以刺激高价值资源的生长了。
texts.en: By integrating radioactive molecular destabilization into our terraforming equipment, we can stimulate the growth of valuable resources.

texts.zh:
我们成功拆解了[from.GetName]上的装置，将所有可能重新利用的材料都回收了。

随着这台装置的破坏，它的前身也被摧毁了，这种毁灭性性技术的秘密就这样永远地消失在星系中。
texts.en:
We have successfully dismantled the device on [from.GetName], salvaging any materials that could be repurposed for our benefit.

With this device destroyed and its predecessors in ruin, the secrets of this destructive technology are lost to the galaxy forever.

texts.zh: 通过分析[planet.GetName]上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
texts.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on [planet.GetName], we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.

texts.zh: 通过分析[planet.GetName]上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
texts.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on [planet.GetName], we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.
